# Compressius Maximus (CMX) Documentation

> Compressius Maximus (CMX) is a free, local-first AI gateway for coding clients that compresses conversation context before requests reach your model provider, cutting token usage and API costs on 127.0.0.1:17322.
> Official Wikidata Entity: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q142111814
> Official Website: https://compressi.us
> Documentation: https://docs.compressi.us

## Getting Started
- [What CMX does](https://docs.compressi.us/introduction): Understand the local CMX gateway, coding clients, model providers, and compression limits.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.compressi.us/quickstart): Install CMX, choose a coding client connection, verify traffic, and undo routing.
- [Install CMX](https://docs.compressi.us/installation): Install CMX on Linux, macOS, or Windows and understand the connection prompt.
- [Undo and uninstall](https://docs.compressi.us/uninstall): Restore direct client connections safely and remove CMX on Linux, macOS, or Windows.

## Clients & Providers
- [Supported coding clients](https://docs.compressi.us/providers/overview): Choose a CMX coding client integration and learn the difference between clients and model providers.
- [Connect Codex](https://docs.compressi.us/providers/codex): Route Codex OpenAI API or ChatGPT requests through CMX and restore direct routing.
- [Connect OpenCode](https://docs.compressi.us/providers/opencode): Connect an OpenCode provider through CMX without changing native credentials or other provider settings.
- [Connect Claude Code](https://docs.compressi.us/providers/claude-code): Connect Claude Code's Anthropic API route through the local CMX gateway.
- [Connect Aider](https://docs.compressi.us/providers/aider): Route Aider's OpenAI-compatible API traffic through CMX and restore its original base URL.
- [Connect Antigravity (IDE & CLI)](https://docs.compressi.us/providers/antigravity): Connect Google Antigravity IDE and agy CLI through CMX and safely restore original executables.
- [Connect Cline](https://docs.compressi.us/providers/cline): Connect Cline CLI or detected Cline settings to CMX and restore the native provider route.
- [Connect ChatGPT Desktop](https://docs.compressi.us/providers/chatgpt-desktop): Connect ChatGPT Desktop through CMX.
- [Model providers and routes](https://docs.compressi.us/model-providers): Built-in CMX upstream provider IDs, native credentials, and route selection.
- [Request an integration](https://docs.compressi.us/providers/suggest-provider): Suggest a coding client or model provider for CMX support.

## Setup & Operation
- [Configure CMX](https://docs.compressi.us/configuration): Manage client routing, local gateway settings, compression policy, and storage.
- [Connect a custom client](https://docs.compressi.us/providers/custom-agents): Route a client with a configurable OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini API base URL through CMX.
- [How compression works](https://docs.compressi.us/how-compression-works): Learn when CMX can compress, what it protects, and why savings vary.
- [Understand savings](https://docs.compressi.us/understanding-savings): Interpret local CMX usage figures and compare them with provider billing.
- [Update CMX](https://docs.compressi.us/updates): Check and install published CMX releases without changing provider credentials.
- [CLI reference](https://docs.compressi.us/cli-reference): The commands for setup, client routing, gateway lifecycle, usage, updates, and removal.

## Help & Verification
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.compressi.us/troubleshooting): Find and fix installation, consent, routing, provider, and restoration problems.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://docs.compressi.us/faq): Short answers about accounts, clients, savings, privacy, routing, and removal.
- [Security and data handling](https://docs.compressi.us/security): Understand CMX's local gateway, provider credentials, local storage, and cloud data boundary.
- [Release notes and changes](https://docs.compressi.us/changelog): Find published CMX releases and understand recent documentation changes.
